title: Download scoped designed order profit evidence pages as PDF
description: A user downloads the current order-profit evidence design as a Chinese PDF. Add a PDF endpoint to the existing dynamic controller and a narrow Infrastructure exporter using existing PDFsharp/SimHeiPdfFontResolver. Revalidate fields/dates/page and reauthorize identity/order-profit menu/fresh ERP scope on every request, using the same server-derived preview even when no preview was requested. Preserve selected field order and current page/date/source-limit coverage; retain explicit original-currency/unknown-cost warnings regardless of selected columns. Render numeric known sales and unknown cost/profit distinctly, paginate rows and wide column bands, give explicit empty evidence, never combine currencies or claim realized profit. Missing font/render failures return a clear error with no corrupt file. Designer retains current request values and handles errors; Excel remains compatible. Development only: reuse existing ERP order-profit menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. No client-supplied identity/scope/rows/amount totals, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Unavailable external environment acceptance must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF revalidates the current selected fields/date/page request and rechecks current identity/menu/customer scope via the same preview; revoked or invalid requests return no file.

Infrastructure PDF preserves selected columns, row/column pagination, original-currency and unknown-basis labels plus page-only/source-limit context and empty evidence; missing font/render failures are explicit.
Designer sends current fields/dates/page to PDF and preserves state on download errors; PDF/UI and Excel compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
